content: The most common protocol used for internet access with Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) is Ethernet. Ethernet is a standardized protocol that allows for the transmission of data over a local area network (LAN) or wide area network (WAN) using copper or fiber optic cables. FTTH connections typically use Ethernet to connect the user's home network to the internet service provider's network.
